purpose: Teach: フロイト/語りかけ/サーカス/サイレン/培っ/エディタ/必殺/イースター

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、フロイトの本、絶対、最近、絶対、読んでるんだよ、本気で、絶対、すごい
lines.en: Mom, Dad's been reading Freud lately — it's really something, isn't it?
lines.style: Bright observation, eyes wide. Quick delivery, genuinely impressed. No sarcasm, just wonder at the oddness of adults. The pause before 'really something' is a small check-in for agreement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、優しく、絶対、孫に、絶対、語りかけてくれるわよね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Mm-hmm. Grandma speaks to you so gently, doesn't she, Sho? You should be grateful for that.
lines.style: Warm, reflective agreement. Not lecturing — more thinking aloud. The words land with quiet affection. A gentle reminder wrapped in approval, not correction. Soft on his name.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、家族で、絶対、サーカス、絶対、見に行きたいよ、ママ、本気で、絶対、お願い
lines.en: Mom, can we go see the circus with the whole family during summer break? Please? I really want to.
lines.style: Direct request with building earnestness. Voice bright at the opening, then settles into genuine wanting. The 'please' is sincere, not manipulative — he means it. Small pause before the final appeal.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 救急車の、本気で、絶対、サイレン、絶対、最近、絶対、よく、絶対、聞こえるわよね、翔くん、絶対、心配
lines.en: We've been hearing ambulance sirens a lot lately, haven't we, Sho? That worries me a little.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Not alarmed, but genuinely concerned beneath the surface. A shift in her attention — she's noticed something real and is checking in with him about it. Soft, not heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、長年、絶対、技術、絶対、培ってきた、絶対、職人さん、絶対、誇り
lines.en: Your grandfather spent all those years perfecting his craft — he's a real craftsman. We should be proud of him.
lines.style: Steady admiration, clear-eyed respect. The words have weight without being grand. Voice warm but grounded, like speaking a simple truth. A moment of genuine appreciation, not performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、新しいエディタ、絶対、買ってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad brought home a new editing program, Sho. It just came.
lines.style: Simple observation, matter-of-fact. A small moment of noticing what her husband did. Not dismissive, not emphatic — just real. The tone is present but unguarded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、必殺技、絶対、ぼくに、絶対、教えてくれるって、絶対、約束したんだ、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: Dad promised to teach you his special technique, didn't he? You must be looking forward to that.
lines.style: Warm recognition of his excitement. Acknowledging the promise, the bond. Voice steady, affirming. A small smile underneath the words — she sees how much this matters to him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今年、本気で、絶対、イースター、絶対、家族で、絶対、楽しもうね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、卵、絶対、いっぱい、絶対、用意するわよ
lines.en: This year let's really enjoy Easter together as a family, okay, Sho? I'm going to get lots and lots of eggs ready for you.
lines.style: Gentle invitation with quiet anticipation. Planning aloud, voice warm. The promise of eggs is concrete affection — a small thing she can do. Voice softens on his name, carries genuine hope for shared joy.
